restoration_note: Teaching describes the three plagues/wars by which Divine Truth defeats the proprium across the three cosmic ages: (1) cosmogonic binding of the King of Darkness in the Living Principle; (2) the Great Fire of the present age that releases, separates, and gathers inward the hidden icons; (3) eschatological splitting — male into the bolos, female into the tomb, with confirmed stone set forever between. Most gaps are line-break completions tightly constrained by Coptic morphology (ⲙⲁⲣϩ̄, ⲁⲧⲙⲣⲣⲉ, ⲧⲙⲁⲍⲱⲁⲙⲧⲉ, ⲁⲧⲥⲍⲓⲙⲉ/ⲧⲥⲍⲓⲙⲉ ⲍⲱⲱⲥ, ⲛⲁⲛⲟⲩⲭⲉ ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ, the standard ⲱⲁ ⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ doxological formula, and ⲟⲩⲙⲡⲏⲩⲉ split across line). {12} is the parallel "ⲁⲩⲡⲍ" mirroring ⲁⲩⲡⲁⲣⲭϩ in the next line. {9} is more open: a 12-char object for "they shall reach __ of stone in their midst forever" — restored as ⲁⲩⲥⲁⲃⲧ̄ ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲟ̄ ("a great wall") on the basis of the spiritual reading's "stone set in their midst forever" as confirmed immutable boundary between Light and Darkness, using the lexicon's ⲡⲥⲁⲃⲧ̄ for the protecting boundary of state.

restorations.basis: Editor's [ⲙⲁ]ⲣϩ̄ completes Lyc. ⲙⲁⲣϩ̄ = ⲙⲟⲣϥ̄ 'bind-him' (with ϩ for ϥ pronominal suffix). The pre-line ⲁⲩ- 'they' joins to give ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲣϩ̄ 'they bound him', closing the first-war binding of the King of Darkness in the Living Principle.

Editor's [ⲁⲧ]ⲙ̄ⲣⲣⲉ = ⲁ-ⲧ-ⲙⲣⲣⲉ 'into/to the bond' parallels the preceding ⲥⲁⲩⲍ̄ ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ 'gathered inward'; the icons are gathered inward to the bond according to their first type (lexicon: bond = ⲙ̄ⲣⲣⲉ).
Editor's [ⲟ]ⲡ completes ⲛⲉϩⲱⲟⲟⲡ, qualitative of ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'be/exist'. Required by the imperfect construction ⲛⲉ-... ϣⲟⲟⲡ 'they were existing' referring to the original pre-mingling state.
Editor's [Ⲧⲙ̄]ⲁⲍⲱⲁⲙⲧⲉ gives ⲧⲙⲁⲍⲱⲁⲙⲧⲉ 'the third (fem.)' agreeing with ⲡⲗⲏⲅⲏ; standard enlarged section-initial parallels Ⲧⲱⲁⲣⲡ (sec. 2399) and Ⲧⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛ̄ⲧⲉ (sec. 2403).
Editor's [ⲛ̄ⲧ]ⲍⲁⲏ = ⲛ̄-ⲧ-ⲍⲁⲏ 'of the last (era)'. Lexicon: ⲡⲍⲁⲏ = 'last/final/consummating', the eschatological third age in which every thing is separated forth.
Editor's [ⲁⲧⲥ]ⲍⲓⲙⲉ = ⲁ-ⲧ-ⲥⲍⲓⲙⲉ 'from the female', completing the male/female separation: active falsity-from-self-love (male) split forth from the corrupt receptive matrix Hyle (female).
Editor's [ⲙⲉ ⲍ]ⲱⲱⲥ completes ⲧⲥⲍⲓⲙⲉ ⲍⲱⲱⲥ 'the female herself/also' from the line break, parallel to ⲧⲥⲍⲁⲩⲧ ⲙⲉⲛ on the previous line.
Editor's ⲛ[ⲁⲛⲟⲩⲭⲉ] = future ⲛⲁ- + ⲛⲟⲩϫⲉ 'shall be cast'; the female (Hyle/Enthumesis of Death) cast inward to the tomb, the state of permanent spiritual death, mirroring the male bound in the bolos.
Editor's ⲁ[ⲍ]ⲟⲩⲛ = Lyc. ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ (Sah. ⲁϩⲟⲩⲛ) 'inward', governed by ⲁⲡⲧⲁⲫⲟⲥ 'to the tomb'. Standard Lyc. orthography.

~12 chars; spiritual reading explicitly says 'Stone set in their midst forever' as 'confirmed, immutable boundary fixing the eternal separation between Light and Darkness'. Lexicon entry: wall = ⲡⲥⲁⲃⲧ̄ ('the protecting boundary / wall around the state'). Construction ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲡⲧⲁⲱϩ ⲅⲁⲣ [a great wall] ⲛ̄ⲱⲛⲉ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲟⲩⲙⲏⲧⲉ 'for they shall set/reach a great wall of stone in their midst' fits exactly.
Editor's restoration of the standard Manichaean doxological formula ⲱⲁ ⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ ⲁ ⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ ⲱⲁ ⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ ⲛⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ̄ 'unto generation of generation, forever and ever', closing the eschatological sealing.

Word ⲟⲩⲙⲡⲏⲩⲉ 'a heaven' split at line break: line 23 ends ⲟⲩⲙⲡ̄- and line 24 begins ⲡⲉ (copula 'is'); the missing letters between are ⲏⲩⲉ, completing 'a heaven (it is), bitter and hard, in which there is no dissolution forth'. Spiritual reading confirms: 'fruit of the Enemy comes to be in a heaven of its own, but a heaven that is bitter and hard.'

Editor's ⲁⲩⲡⲍ ('they split', Lyc. reflex of ⲡⲱϩ) parallels ⲁⲩⲡⲍ ⲛⲡⲁⲣⲭϩ on the next line; cognate-object pairing ⲁⲩⲡⲍ ⲛ̄ⲙⲁⲡϩ ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲡϥ̄ 'they split him with splittings, they have split him' mirrors ⲁⲩⲡⲍ ⲛⲡⲁⲣⲭϩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲁⲩⲡⲁⲣⲭϥ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ — the proprium's own scattering returned upon itself as eternal condition.
